# FAQ-028 Engineering FAQ #28

Revision: Rev A

Q1: What lubricant should be used for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L4-RR01)?
A1: Use lubricant part number CFW-LUB-723 for EQ-P2-L4-RR01. See lubrication scheduling and compatibility notes in MM-P2-L3-RR01.

Q2: What lubricant should be used for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03)?
A2: Use lubricant part number CFW-LUB-101 for EQ-P2-L2-RR03. Refer to MM-P2-L3-RR01 for approved lubricants and SOP-P2-L3-05 for application method.

Q3: What lubricant should be used for Machining radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L3-RR01)?
A3: Use lubricant part number CFW-LUB-225 for EQ-P2-L3-RR01. Verify stock and transfer procedures per SOP-P2-L3-05 and MM-P2-L3-RR01.

Q4: What is the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01)?
A4: Set mandrel clamp bolts to 635 N·m on EQ-P1-L1-RR01. Confirm torque sequence and verification steps in SOP-P3-L1-02 and document results in the maintenance record referenced by MM-P2-L3-RR01.

Q5: What is the main ram bolt torque for Hot Forge hydraulic forging press #1 (EQ-P3-L1-HP01)?
A5: Set main ram bolts to 1425 N·m on EQ-P3-L1-HP01. Follow the torque procedure and re-torque checks in SOP-P3-L1-02; record compliance per MM-P2-L3-RR01.

Related documents: MM-P2-L3-RR01, SOP-P2-L3-05, SOP-P3-L1-02

Notes:
- The answers above provide the exact part numbers and torque values required for the specified equipment.
- Always follow the referenced SOP for sequence, tooling, and verification; nonconformance requires escalation per MM-P2-L3-RR01.
